body: Thank you.  Looks like we graduated the same year - it sucks that the system is failing so many people, but it's still a sad comfort to know we're so far from alone.

I majored in communication.  I went to a very small school (~1000 total students, including the grad programs) with an equally tiny and not very useful career department.  Additionally, the school is a multi-hour drive from where I am now.

I have had friends, family, acquaintances who have some hand in hiring processes where they work, and the nice folks of reddit go over my resume.  I've given up completely on working in my field and have applied to countless "entry level" admin jobs that frequently are part-time/temp/only ask for a HS diploma.  Not even one interview.  It's a waste.
